reason: We make fresh coriander chutney in the mixer at home for a fraction of the cost, and these flip-top nozzles always end up with a gross, dried crust after two days in the fridge.
objection: Will the flip-top nozzle get crusty and clogged after 3 days in the fridge?
would_change_my_mind: A self-cleaning silicone valve nozzle that prevents crusting and a price point below ₹50.
